name: scaffold-shiny-app
description: Scaffold a new Shiny application using golem (production R package), rhino (enterprise), or vanilla (quick prototype) structure. Covers framework selection, project initialization, and first module creation. Use to start a new interactive web app in R, create a dashboard or data explorer prototype, set up a production Shiny app as an R package with golem, or bootstrap an enterprise Shiny project with rhino.
